operations.meaning: Read the authenticated principal's bounded owned HTML addresses and successful root producer receipts without a run admission. Report partial coverage while nested producer receipt inventory remains incomplete. Library summaries do not claim a dependency inspection.

Resolve a digest through a principal-owned source address or the principal's successful retained producer receipt, then inspect its bytes offline. A digest or caller-supplied receipt grants no access.
Read one authorized immutable source revision and inspect its original UTF-8 HTML without execution. Missing dependencies remain explicit.
Reauthorize an exact owned source revision and return its verified bytes in content-bytes.v1 JSON. Executable HTML is never served on the privileged API origin.
Reauthorize the retained digest through an owned source address or successful principal-scoped producer receipt, then return exactly the selected immutable bytes in content-bytes.v1 JSON.
Caller-bound publication authority: sites. Resolve only explicit immutable publication bindings; never render a source or admit reader jobs.
Caller-bound publication authority: list. Resolve only explicit immutable publication bindings; never render a source or admit reader jobs.
Caller-bound publication authority: publication. Resolve only explicit immutable publication bindings; never render a source or admit reader jobs.
Caller-bound publication authority: history. Resolve only explicit immutable publication bindings; never render a source or admit reader jobs.
Caller-bound publication authority: request. Resolve only explicit immutable publication bindings; never render a source or admit reader jobs.
Anonymous read of an active pinned publication or its exact declared asset only. Withdrawal revokes every path. Return verified bytes in JSON, never executable HTML on the API origin.
Explicit authorized publish of one selected publication through the estate writer, with immutable source verification, optimistic concurrency and a durable idempotency receipt.
Explicit authorized update of one selected publication through the estate writer, with immutable source verification, optimistic concurrency and a durable idempotency receipt.
Explicit authorized withdraw of one selected publication through the estate writer, with immutable source verification, optimistic concurrency and a durable idempotency receipt.
Anonymous read of an active pinned publication or its exact declared asset only. Withdrawal revokes every path. Return verified bytes in JSON, never executable HTML on the API origin.

Reauthorize the original page and its pinned manifest; return only the exact listed dependency bytes. A path or digest alone grants no access. Query path carries nested directories through hosted ingress.
